coaching.title: Today's Run
coaching.message: 40–50 min Z2 easy, no vert work. You're 35 days out in taper and your resting HR is 56—excellent. Yesterday's 12-miler at 132 bpm was solid, but you've only logged 31 miles this week against 47 last week; the volume drop is correct for taper. Today is a shakeout day before your Saturday long run. Keep it conversational, sub-130 bpm, mostly flat or rolling. This primes your system without accumulating fatigue. Skip any tempo or hill repeats; taper isn't the time to prove fitness.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You slept 6.48 hours—below your 30-day average of 8.03h. Prioritize carbs today: aim for 2–2.5 g/kg body weight, spread across meals and snacks. With travel and a busy exec schedule, don't rely on willpower; pack rice cakes, dates, or energy bars. During today's easy run (40–50 min), you don't need gels, but drink fluid if it's warm. Post-run, hit 20–30g protein + 60–80g carbs within 60 minutes to start glycogen repletion for Saturday's long effort.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Sleep is the chink in your armor right now. Your recovery score is solid (73/100), but 6.48 hours is not sustainable in taper—you need 8–9 hours before a 50K. Tonight, aim for 8.5+ hours: cut screens by 21:30, keep your room cool (65–68°F), and skip alcohol. No massage or ice bath today; just easy movement. Your resting HR trend (56 bpm) shows you're recovering well, so rest isn't the issue—it's duration. Make sleep non-negotiable for the next 35 days.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: You're in taper, and the mental game shifts: doubt creeps in because the volume drop feels like detraining. It isn't. Your body is consolidating 29 weeks of work. Saturday will be a 90–120 min moderate run with alpine vert; treat it as a confidence builder, not a peak effort. Use today's easy shakeout to run some race-pace surges on hills (2–3 min at 50K pace, 2–3 min recovery) to remind yourself you're sharp. Trust the plan: taper works.
